import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq

N = 150000
TARGET = 10.0

# P = (a, b, ..., b) with a + (N-1)*b = 1
def forward(a):
    b = (1 - a) / (N - 1)
    return a * np.log(a * N) + (1 - a) * np.log(b * N)

def backward(a):
    b = (1 - a) / (N - 1)
    return (1 - a) * np.log(1 / (b * N))

a_f = brentq(lambda a: forward(a) - TARGET, 1/N, 1 - 1e-15, xtol=1e-18)
a_b = brentq(lambda a: backward(a) - TARGET, 1/N, 1 - 1e-15, xtol=1e-18)
print("a_forward:", a_f, "a_backward:", a_b)
print("gap:", a_b - a_f)

# Two-parameter family: k top probs = a, rest = b
def build(k, a):
    b = (1 - k * a) / (N - k)
    p = np.full(N, b)
    p[:k] = a
    return p

def kl_f(p):
    return np.sum(p * np.log(p * N))

def kl_b(p):
    return np.sum((1/N) * np.log(1 / (p * N)))

from scipy.optimize import fsolve
def eqs(x):
    k, a = x
    p = build(int(k), a)
    return [kl_f(p) - TARGET, kl_b(p) - TARGET]

x, info, ier, msg = sol

p = build(int(x[0]), x[1])
print("sum:", p.sum(), "min:", p.min(), "max:", p.max())
print("KL_f:", kl_f(p), "KL_b:", kl_b(p))
